marketing_wrapper: All 6 share one template: pure black backdrop, a two-line white caption with one phrase on a hand-drawn yellow highlighter swash (top ~30%), and a frameless white phone outline cropped at the bottom showing ~60% real UI. 02, 03, 05 and 06 lift one card out of the screen and enlarge it (marketing pop-out); the rest of the UI under it is real.

typography.display: SF Pro bold for screen titles ('Search', 'Book Threads', 'Thread'); the Threads '@' glyph mark is the only brand display element in-app. Marketing captions use a different grotesque (not in UI).
typography.numerals: proportional SF, small grey counts beside action icons
typography.weights: semibold username, regular post body, regular grey timestamps and counts; bold large titles
typography.case_and_tracking: sentence case, default tracking; lowercase usernames dominate the visual texture

palette.accent_strategy: Monochrome chrome: black is the action colour (filled black Follow/Join pills, black poll bar, filled black home tab). Colour appears only as semantic signals (blue verified badge and blue links/community names, red filled heart when liked, red LIVE pill, green online dot) and in user avatars and media.
palette.source: palette.json 01-06 (#ffffff UI, #000000 marketing backdrop and UI text, #f3f4f3/#f6f5f4 grey fills); blue and red read visually

shape.radius_language: mixed: circle avatars; ~12-16pt on poll bars, quote cards and chat bubbles; ~8pt black buttons; grey rounded-square (~10pt) behind the compose '+' tab
shape.borders_shadows: hairline grey separators between posts; thin grey vertical thread line connecting replies; no card shadows in real UI (shadows only on marketing pop-outs)

liquid_glass_visible: no: tab bar and top bars are flat white
density: medium; ~4-5 posts per screen, 12-16pt vertical padding per post, text-led rows with left avatar gutter
layout: Single-column text-first timeline: centred '@' mark top bar, composer row ('What's new?'), then posts as avatar + username/time + body + action row, separated by hairlines.
navigation: Bottom tab bar, 5 icon-only tabs (home filled, send/DM, '+' compose in a grey rounded square, heart activity, person profile); no labels. Top bar: hamburger left, logo centre, search right on home; standard back chevron with large bold title elsewhere. Native-feeling but custom-drawn.
imagery_and_icons: Custom outline icon set at ~1.5pt stroke (heart, speech bubble, repost arrows, paper-plane send); filled only for selected state (home tab, liked heart in red). Imagery is user avatars and post media only. Emoji appear inside user content and as reactions in live chat.
signature_visual_move: Pure black-and-white chrome where black itself is the accent (black Follow pills, black poll bar, filled black home tab), leaving avatars, media and a few semantic blues and reds as the only colour.

direction_fit.primary: posture-only: feed core with monochrome chrome (black as the action colour, user media the only hue); close to the 'Inherited Parent Grammar' anti-reference shape
direction_fit.why: The screens confirm the text record's 'content-deferent monochrome feed': no brand hue in UI, SF type, standard feed anatomy and Instagram-like 5-icon tab bar. The only authored element is the '@' mark and the highlighter swash, which lives on marketing, not in the app.

notes: The yellow highlighter swash is marketing-only brand evidence. The search frame advertises 'What people are saying, summarized by AI'. Hide/send icons and the compose '+' in a soft grey square match Instagram's tab treatment.
